bodies.source_requirement: Requires gestational-age-staged maternal + fetal source anatomy (e.g. segmented maternal MRI/CT atlases by trimester); must not be produced by inflating the female abdomen.

Requires fetal anatomical source data by gestational week (fetal MRI atlases / embryology references); fetal circulation shunts (foramen ovale, ductus arteriosus, ductus venosus) must be source-backed.
Requires neonatal source anatomy (fontanelles, thymus, relative liver size); adult scaling is prohibited.
Requires infant source anatomy; adult scaling is prohibited.
Requires toddler source anatomy; adult scaling is prohibited.
Requires child source anatomy (growth plates, ossification centres, airway dimensions); adult scaling is prohibited.
Requires adolescent source anatomy; adult scaling is prohibited.
Requires older-adult source anatomy; normal ageing must be kept separate from pathology.
